caption:
Deterministic Null Baseline — 9/10 Track-A bounded ties vs. 6 LLMs · +45.8 to +95.0 pp LLM lead on open SWE/BFCL suites (reported_j)

Against a SHA-256 pre-committed zero-model lookup arm (Shape D, bit-exact in Rust/C++20/Go/Julia/Python), 6 LLMs tied or trailed on 9/10 bounded template cells (N=2,840) — yet led +45.8 to +95.0 pp on open suites.

• Provenance: Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (not externally peer-reviewed; studio voice is_aigc=true)
• Telemetry: reported_j (Apple M5 Max Darwin ri_energy_nj L3 counter on local Shape D & open-weight runs; cloud API watts unmetered.)
• Essay: https://blog.openie.dev/posts/deterministic-null/
• Paper: https://research.openie.dev/papers/deterministic-null/
• Replicate: https://github.com/openIE-dev/openie-research-experiments/tree/main/replicate
